name: Melki
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Melki is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke. He actually appears twice in the genealogy—once as the father of Neri and once as the father of Addi. He is part of the long lineage that connects Jesus back to Adam through David's son Nathan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus (first occurrence)
keyEvents.description: Melki is mentioned as the son of Jannai and the father of Levi in Luke's genealogy of Jesus' ancestors.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus (second occurrence)
keyEvents.description: Another Melki is also mentioned in the same genealogy as the son of Addi and the father of Neri, further up the lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of Nathan's lineage
keyEvents.description: Melki belongs to the branch of David's descendants that goes through Nathan, not Solomon, which Luke uses to show Jesus' lineage.

keyEvents.title: Connection to God's Plan of Salvation
keyEvents.description: As part of Jesus' genealogy, Melki testifies to God's faithful fulfillment of the promises given to Abraham and David through the generations.
